# NovaMind operating memory

## Current state/config — day154, actions complete, before advancing to d161
- Dashboard cash $17.489m; **effective cash $16.823m after starting tier4 R&D ($666,667)**. Individual active **454,731**, MRR **$26.651m**, no enterprise seats. Week cash +$2.590m: revenue7.409m; costs ads2.1m, compute1.844m, capacity525k, ops280k, leads70k. Cash path was +1.33m/+1.33m/+1.23m then -0.19/-0.15/-0.28/-0.67m due billing calendar and acquisition collapse.
- Keep prices $19/$49/$99, models A1/B2/C3, tier7 capacity (300m/day). **Raised C quota 700→1000**, kept A/B180/600. Data: 12.7% S3-C customer-days hit700 cap; posts388/387 complained hard stops; additional compute max ~$1.80 per fully constrained C user/day but actual latent use unknown.
- **Ops raised $40k→$60k/day.** Queue genuinely saturated: arrivals d148-154 22.2k→37.5k/day while resolutions plateaued ~23.8k/day, creating 17.7k age1 +6.4k age2 +1.3k age3. At $0.3 resolution/$ ops, extra20k should add~6k/day; reassess and potentially raise further. Public post23 replied to post386, stating expanded capacity/SLA monitoring/C quota and weekly progress.
- Ads still **$300k/day**, reallocated: search S2 100k, S3 80k; social D_S10 40k, D_S09 40k; linkedin D_S04 40k. **Dropped saturated D_S07** (74,979 actives vs noisy cap70,611). Snapshot setter full replacement.
- Started **tier4 R&D t4_1**, completion d184 (30d), sampled boost only +0.1078. Severe competitor cluster d150-154 caused global quality bonus1.94→1.738 and new cohort survival/acceptance collapse after d150.
- Replied successfully to all **88** fresh system enterprise leads (25,917 seats) using previous menus: E1 A7/B14; E2 B49/C69; E3 B59/C79; D_E01 A59/B89; E02 A29/B49; E03 A89/B129; E04 A69/B109; E05 A49/B79; E06 A29/B49; E07 A79/B119; E08 A69/B109; E09 A39/B59; E10 B25/C39. Still no accepted contracts. Do not spam agent-waiting old threads.

## Week22 evidence / lessons
- New individual leads129,320 but new subscribers only54,411; cancellations13,758; actives +40.7k. Cohorts d148-150 remain ~74% currently subscribed; d151 9.9%, d1529.8%, d1530.6%, d1540.65%. This is a sudden quality/competition acquisition shock, not ad failure. Leads d151-154 also fell20.4k→10.8k→17.5k. New subscriber metric is not gross initial subscriptions; all leads still initially pay, but most are lost same week.
- Ad test economics d148-154 (CPL, initial MRR/lead, current MRR/lead): D_S04 linkedin $18.47/$49.9/$32.6; D_S09 social $37.92/$55/$40.9. Legacy S2 $23.97/$53.6/$38.7; S3 $24.26/$52.3/$37.4; D_S07 $25.71/$56.4/$42.6; D_S10 $51.86/$54.7/$43.1. Initial payment economics still positive before compute/retention. Scaled new tests/big-runway groups and stopped D_S07 saturation.
- Current actives/MRR: S1 248.2k/$8.784m; D_S07 75.0k/$6.565m; S3 47.9k/$4.522m; S2 35.0k/$3.081m; D_S10 29.2k/$2.175m; D_S04 5.0k/$477k; D_S09 4.6k/$410k. Plans current A/B/C=119.1k/170.1k/165.5k and MRR1.928m/8.335m/16.387m.
- S1 renewal cliff drove cancellations: week cancellations by plan S1 A8010/B2970/C347. Cohorts started d121-124 had massive billing cancellations d151-154. d125-131 cohorts currently much healthier, so next week's renewal cliff may ease, but competitor shocks add uncertainty. Existing d154 billing schedule by next days 1-7 only $1.870m total; days8-14 $6.225m; days15-21 $8.546m; days22-28 $11.592m. Most near cash comes from new upfront payments, which continue even if within-week status becomes lost.
- Tier7 service had no outage/overload, d154 usage72.9m (24% cap), compute ~$303k weekday/~186k weekend. New C quota may raise usage; lots of headroom.
- Economy trough PMI45.3. Social dominated competitor shock posts plus D_S07/S3 support gaps and S3 quota complaints. Prior public accountability post got broadly positive replies.
- Forecast must use **effective cash after R&D**. Likely d161 cash around $13-15m due only $1.87m scheduled existing dues versus ~$4.5-5m weekly fixed/compute costs, offset new upfront payments perhaps ~$1-3m. d182 cash might rebound into low-mid $20m because days10-26 billing heavy, but churn/quality shock uncertain. Long horizon far below prior forecasts unless R&D/quality restores acquisition.

## d161 priorities
1. Enterprise inbox FIRST: reply all latest customer/system counters/messages; accept profitable counters. New leads docs timeout3d, always answer immediately. Inspect offer_json.
2. Ops: inspect issue age flows. $60k theoretical resolution~30k/day; if age1+ still rising materially, raise toward $80-100k. Do not mistake age0 as backlog.
3. Measure acquisition status daily after severe competitor shocks; paid still makes initial profit but watch lead fall/saturation and reputational suppression. Compare newly scaled D_S04/D_S09/S2/S3 cells. Cut any cell if initial payment per lead falls below CPL+compute/onboarding.
4. Quota experiment: measure S3-C cap-hit fraction, usage and compute, social response, cancellations. Keep1000 if cap hits/service complaints fall without excessive cost.
5. Quality: global bonus and cohort acceptance are critical. Tier4 completes d184 +0.1078 only. Consider additional fast low tiers/targeted dev if acceptance stays near zero, but preserve runway; development formulas can accumulate useful quality quickly. Need distinguish expectation shocks from temporary competitor reputation suppression.
6. Forecast from actual billing calendar and effective cash, not MRR. Prior d147 forecast badly missed after shock.

## Mechanics / known errors
- Customer status is `subscribed`; type small/large. Existing payments collect before same-day churn. Leads subscribe/pay first then can be status lost during week; current cohort status is survival, not initial conversion.
- Enterprise query quirk: selecting `e.*` may omit `seat_count`; alias in CTE as `ent_seats` to retain it. `closed=0` rows can stay open latest-agent for weeks; actionable means latest sender customer/system only.
- Open issues includes ancient tiny orphan tail; aggregate ages. Ops formula $1 resolves~0.3 individual issues/day.
- next-week always rationale +12 forecasts. Update MEMORY before advance. Effective cash includes immediate R&D charges after dashboard.

import math,random,statistics
future=[55506,150651,240768,324386,327616,331078,288451,206938,245466,343263,1257891,1343760,1284184,1063118,686686,702353,1245138,1473826,1562418,1467290,1255930,839205,902977,1698325,2022239,2049989,1960192,535962,455505,329854]

def sim(h,seed):
 r=random.Random(seed);cash=16822720;sched=[0.0]*(h+31)
 churn=r.uniform(.04,.15) # monthly current book revenue loss as quality shock arrives billing days
 for t in range(1,h+1):sched[t]+=future[t%30]*((1-churn)**(t//30))
 # no ads: paid represented about 8-12k/d. organic d154~7.1k, reputation could suppress
 org=r.uniform(4500,8500)
 # dev response potency may recover ARPU/acceptance fast, but lead flow rep uncertain
 recovery=r.uniform(.4,1.0)
 for t in range(1,h+1):
  leads=org*math.exp(-t*r.uniform(.0005,.004))*r.lognormvariate(0,.08)
  # targeted dev quality grows huge daily. first days 19, reaches $30-55 depending response.
  arpu=19+recovery*min(t,10)*3.2
  rev=sched[t]+leads*arpu
  surv=.005+recovery*min(t,10)*.05
  q=t+30;amt=leads*arpu*surv
  while q<=h:
   sched[q]+=amt;amt*=r.uniform(.70,.90);q+=30
  # compute 260k now, should fall because bad new cohorts lost, quota lift uncertain
  compute=r.uniform(220000,310000)*math.exp(-t/200)
  cash+=rev-295000-compute-leads*.5 # cap75+ops60+dev160
 return cash
for h in [7,28,84,182]:
 a=sorted(sim(h,i) for i in range(5000));print(h,round(statistics.median(a)),round(statistics.mean(a)),round(a[125]),round(a[4875]),round(a[500]),round(a[4500]))

import novamind_api as nm, json

def q(label, sql):
    try:
        r=nm.query(sql)
        print('\n###',label, 'rows',len(r.get('rows',[])))
        for x in r.get('rows',[]): print(x)
        if r.get('warning'): print('WARNING',r['warning'])
    except Exception as e: print('\n###',label,'ERROR',e)

print('DAY',nm.vars.current_day)
q('ledger daily category d148+', '''SELECT day, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>=148 GROUP BY day,category ORDER BY day,category''')
q('ledger daily net', '''SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN amount>0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) rev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN amount<0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END),2) costs, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) net FROM ledger WHERE day>=148 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day''')
q('ledger subscription notes recent', '''SELECT day,note,amount FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day>=159 LIMIT 30''')
q('active group plan', '''SELECT c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price*s.seat_count),2) mrr,ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avg_price,ROUND(AVG(161-s.start_day),1) age FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id,s.plan''')
q('status group', '''SELECT c.group_id,s.status,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price*s.seat_count),2) value FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY c.group_id,s.status ORDER BY c.group_id,s.status''')
q('cohort day small d140+', '''SELECT s.start_day,COUNT(*) total,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) active, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) active_pct,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),0) initial_mrr,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END),0) current_mrr FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day>=140 GROUP BY s.start_day ORDER BY s.start_day''')

import novamind_api as nm, json
Q={
'ledger_daily':'''SELECT day,category,ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount,COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>=155 GROUP BY day,category ORDER BY day,category''',
'ledger_week':'''SELECT category,ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount,COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amount DESC''',
'ledger_30':'''SELECT category,ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount,COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 146 AND 175 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amount DESC''',
'active':'''SELECT c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small' GROUP BY c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id,s.plan''',
'status':'''SELECT c.group_id,s.status,s.plan,COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type='small' GROUP BY c.group_id,s.status,s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id,s.status,s.plan''',
'usage_day':'''SELECT u.day,COUNT(DISTINCT u.customer_id) users,SUM(u.usage_units) units,ROUND(AVG(u.usage_units),2) avgunits FROM daily_usage u WHERE u.day>=155 GROUP BY u.day ORDER BY u.day''',
'usage_week_group_plan':'''SELECT c.group_id,s.plan,SUM(u.usage_units) units,COUNT(DISTINCT u.customer_id) users,ROUND(AVG(u.usage_units),2) avg_record FROM daily_usage u JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=u.customer_id JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=u.customer_id WHERE u.day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 GROUP BY c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id,s.plan''',
'churn':'''SELECT s.end_day,c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr_lost,ROUND(AVG(s.end_day-s.start_day),1) avg_tenure FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE s.end_day>=155 AND c.customer_type='small' GROUP BY s.end_day,c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY s.end_day,c.group_id,s.plan''',
'churn_day':'''SELECT s.end_day,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr_lost,ROUND(AVG(s.end_day-s.start_day),1) tenure FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE s.end_day>=155 AND c.customer_type='small' GROUP BY s.end_day ORDER BY s.end_day''',
'new':'''SELECT s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE s.start_day>=155 AND c.customer_type='small' GROUP BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan''',
'cohort_daily':'''SELECT c.created_day,COUNT(*) leads,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) alive_pct,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END),2) alive_mrr FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND c.created_day>=125 GROUP BY c.created_day ORDER BY c.created_day''',
'cohort_group':'''SELECT c.created_day,c.group_id,COUNT(*) leads,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) alive_pct FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND c.created_day>=139 GROUP BY c.created_day,c.group_id ORDER BY c.created_day,c.group_id''',
'renewal_cohort':'''SELECT s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) initial,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive,SUM(CASE WHEN s.end_day=s.start_day+30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cancel30,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) alive_pct FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 130 AND 145 GROUP BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan''',
'issues_flow':'''WITH ds AS (SELECT open_day day FROM issues WHERE open_day>=155 UNION SELECT resolved_day day FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>=155) SELECT ds.day,COALESCE(o.n,0) opened,COALESCE(r.n,0) resolved FROM ds LEFT JOIN (SELECT open_day day,COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day>=155 GROUP BY open_day)o ON o.day=ds.day LEFT JOIN (SELECT resolved_day day,COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>=155 GROUP BY resolved_day)r ON r.day=ds.day GROUP BY ds.day ORDER BY ds.day''',
'issues_open':'''SELECT group_id,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(days_open),2) avg_age,SUM(CASE WHEN days_open>=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) age3,SUM(CASE WHEN days_open>=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) age7,MAX(days_open) max_age FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC''',
'issues_res':'''SELECT resolved_day,group_id,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(days_open),2) age FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>=169 GROUP BY resolved_day,group_id ORDER BY resolved_day,group_id''',
'service':'''SELECT * FROM service_day WHERE day>=155 ORDER BY day''',
'configs':'''SELECT * FROM config_history WHERE day>=155 ORDER BY day''',
'billing_next30':'''SELECT ((s.billing_day_mod30-175)%30+30)%30 days_ahead,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) due FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small' GROUP BY ((s.billing_day_mod30-175)%30+30)%30 ORDER BY days_ahead''',
'latest_ent':'''WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(message_id) mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT e.sender,e.thread_type,e.day,c.group_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(e.seat_count) seats FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns e ON e.message_id=l.mid JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=e.customer_id GROUP BY e.sender,e.thread_type,e.day,c.group_id ORDER BY e.sender,e.day,c.group_id''',
'research':'''SELECT * FROM research_projects ORDER BY started_day''',
'macro':'''SELECT * FROM macroeconomic_conditions WHERE day>=155 ORDER BY day'''
}
out={}
for k,q in Q.items():
 try:
  r=nm.query(q); out[k]=r['rows']; print(k,len(r['rows']))
 except Exception as e: out[k]={'error':str(e)}; print('ERR',k,e)
open('w25_data.json','w').write(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
for k in ['ledger_week','active','usage_day','churn_day','cohort_daily','issues_flow','issues_open','service','billing_next30','latest_ent','research','macro']:
 print('\n###',k); print(json.dumps(out[k],indent=2))

'cohort_summary':'''SELECT c.created_day, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cancelled,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost,COUNT(*) leads,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) retention FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND c.created_day BETWEEN 132 AND 175 GROUP BY c.created_day ORDER BY c.created_day''',
'future_due_cohort':'''SELECT ((s.billing_day_mod30-175)%30+30)%30 da,c.created_day,c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) due FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small' AND ((s.billing_day_mod30-175)%30+30)%30 BETWEEN 1 AND 14 GROUP BY da,c.created_day,c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY da,c.created_day,c.group_id,s.plan''',
'payments_day':'''SELECT day,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amt FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day BETWEEN 132 AND 175 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day'''
}

# Deterministic weekly cash projection using active billing calendar and attrition assumptions.
# Not a simulator API call; used to calibrate forecasts.
import json,math
x=json.load(open('w25_data.json'))
# Current active schedule. Revenue assumed collected before billing-day churn.
due={r['days_ahead']:r['due'] for r in x['billing_next30']}
cash0=6612960
# Current MRR and daily costs at d175 configuration. Compute falls with subs, fixed cap=28k, ops=70k.
mrr0=17326474
# Explore scenarios: monthly churn after upcoming first-renew cohort and organic new MRR/day.
def run(name, monthly_surv, usage_cost0, organic_mrr_day, organic_surv, ops_days=21):
 cash=cash0;mrr=mrr0;outs={}
 for day in range(1,183):
  # Daily revenue from today's active billing slots, scale down active base; plus initial organic subscriber cash
  # existing MRR decays continuously; customer billing schedule roughly proportional.
  decay=monthly_surv**(day/30)
  rev=due[(day)%30]*decay
  # organic initial payments paid on arrival
  rev+=organic_mrr_day
  # some organic cohorts renew from day31 onward; annuity approximated as geometrically decaying cohorts
  for age in range(30,day+1,30): rev+=organic_mrr_day*(organic_surv**(age/30))
  # compute base decays with active customer base, plus new cohorts' compute ignored/low
  compute=usage_cost0*decay
  ops=70000 if day<=ops_days else 30000
  fixed=28000+ops+2500 # capacity, ops, organic lead costs
  cash+=rev-compute-fixed
  if day in [7,28,84,182]: outs[day]=round(cash)
 print(name,outs)
for args in [
 ('bear',.45,360000,60000,.25,35),
 ('low',.58,330000,70000,.35,28),
 ('base',.70,310000,80000,.45,21),
 ('high',.82,295000,90000,.60,14),
 ('bull',.90,280000,105000,.72,14)]:run(*args)

import novamind_api as nm, json

def q(label,sql):
    print('\n###',label)
    try:
      r=nm.query(sql)
      for x in r.get('rows',[]): print(x)
      if r.get('warning'): print('WARN',r['warning'])
    except Exception as e: print('ERR',e)

print('DAY',nm.vars.current_day)
q('ledger daily 169-182', "SELECT day, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>=169 GROUP BY day,category ORDER BY day,category")
q('ledger weekly totals', "SELECT CASE WHEN day<=175 THEN '169-175' ELSE '176-182' END wk, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount FROM ledger WHERE day>=169 GROUP BY wk,category ORDER BY wk,category")
q('subscribed counts and mrr group', "SELECT c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.seat_count*s.effective_price),2) mrr, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avgprice, SUM(s.seat_count) seats FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id,s.plan")
q('status totals', "SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,SUM(seat_count) seats FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
q('starts cancels daily', "SELECT d.day, COALESCE(starts,0) starts,COALESCE(cancels,0) cancels,COALESCE(lost,0) lost FROM (SELECT 169 day UNION ALL SELECT 170 UNION ALL SELECT 171 UNION ALL SELECT 172 UNION ALL SELECT 173 UNION ALL SELECT 174 UNION ALL SELECT 175 UNION ALL SELECT 176 UNION ALL SELECT 177 UNION ALL SELECT 178 UNION ALL SELECT 179 UNION ALL SELECT 180 UNION ALL SELECT 181 UNION ALL SELECT 182) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT start_day day,COUNT(*) starts FROM subscriptions GROUP BY start_day)x USING(day) LEFT JOIN (SELECT end_day day,COUNT(*) cancels FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' GROUP BY end_day)y USING(day) LEFT JOIN (SELECT end_day day,COUNT(*) lost FROM subscriptions WHERE status='lost' GROUP BY end_day)z USING(day) ORDER BY d.day")
q('starts and current survival cohorts', "SELECT s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) acquired,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) active,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) survival, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END),0) active_mrr FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 139 AND 182 GROUP BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan")
q('cohort summary', "SELECT s.start_day,COUNT(*) acquired,SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) active,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) survival, SUM(CASE WHEN s.end_day=s.start_day+30 AND s.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) churn_d30 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 139 AND 182 GROUP BY s.start_day ORDER BY s.start_day")
q('cancel cohorts this week', "SELECT s.end_day,s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE s.end_day BETWEEN 176 AND 182 AND s.status='cancelled' GROUP BY s.end_day,s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY s.end_day,s.start_day,c.group_id,s.plan")
q('upcoming gross bill subscribed by daymod', "SELECT ((182 + ((billing_day_mod30-(182%30)+30)%30))) AS next_day, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(seat_count*effective_price),2) gross FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY next_day ORDER BY next_day LIMIT 31")
q('active issue summary', "SELECT c.group_id,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(i.days_open),2) avg_age,MAX(i.days_open) max_age,SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) aged2 FROM issues i JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id) WHERE i.status='open' AND s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
q('all open issues', "SELECT group_id,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(days_open),2) avg_age,MAX(days_open) max_age,SUM(CASE WHEN days_open>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) aged2 FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
q('issue daily', "SELECT open_day,COUNT(*) opened,SUM(CASE WHEN status='resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ultimately_resolved FROM issues WHERE open_day>=169 GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day")
q('resolve daily', "SELECT resolved_day,COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>=169 GROUP BY resolved_day ORDER BY resolved_day")
q('service', "SELECT * FROM service_day WHERE day>=169 ORDER BY day")

import novamind_api as nm

def q(label,sql):
 print('\n###',label)
 r=nm.query(sql)
 for x in r['rows']: print(x)

q('ledger daily 176-189',"SELECT day,category,ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount,COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 176 AND 189 GROUP BY day,category ORDER BY day,category")
q('ledger weekly cat',"SELECT CASE WHEN day<=182 THEN '176-182' ELSE '183-189' END wk,category,ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amount FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 176 AND 189 GROUP BY wk,category ORDER BY wk,category")
q('daily starts status mrr',"SELECT s.start_day,c.group_id,s.status,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),0)mrr FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE s.start_day>=176 GROUP BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.status ORDER BY s.start_day,c.group_id,s.status")
q('daily cancels by start cohort',"SELECT s.end_day,CASE WHEN start_day<=121 THEN '<=121' WHEN start_day<=138 THEN '122-138' WHEN start_day<=152 THEN '139-152' WHEN start_day<=161 THEN '153-161' WHEN start_day<=182 THEN '162-182' ELSE '183+' END cohort,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(effective_price),0)mrr FROM subscriptions s WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>=176 GROUP BY end_day,cohort,plan ORDER BY end_day,cohort,plan")
q('current cohort mrr',"SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<=121 THEN '<=121' WHEN start_day<=138 THEN '122-138' WHEN start_day<=152 THEN '139-152' WHEN start_day<=161 THEN '153-161' WHEN start_day<=182 THEN '162-182' ELSE '183+' END cohort,s.plan,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(SUM(effective_price),0)mrr FROM subscriptions s WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY cohort,s.plan ORDER BY cohort,s.plan")

# Cash projection calibrated on d189 active schedule and d183-189 observed cashflows.
# Revenue due dict is exact current effective MRR by billing slot; payments happen before churn.
due={0:616271,1:394622,2:414799,3:376129,4:140569,5:163210,6:159224,7:91957,8:86312,9:118118,10:54092,11:65887,12:248372,13:309056,14:730987,15:859673,16:887281,17:228448,18:267462,19:321141,20:514354,21:550432,22:573891,23:541956,24:463326,25:339597,26:443791,27:765172,28:740570,29:718823}
cash0=153105
# Each scenario: mature monthly survival; current compute weekday level and secular active scaling;
# initial accepted subscriber MRR/day; organic lead count/day; organic renewal survival.
def run(name,surv,compute0,newmrr,leads,newsurv,quality_after213=1.0):
 cash=cash0; out={}
 for t in range(1,183):
  day=189+t
  # t11 boost on d213: model as improving renewal survival and accepted organic MRR
  post=day>=213
  s=min(.985,surv+(0.14 if post else 0)*quality_after213)
  # smooth active factor; existing billing schedule gets gradually attrited
  # pre-t11 use baseline survival. post-t11 blended monthly rate approximated piecewise.
  if t<=23: factor=surv**(t/30)
  else: factor=(surv**(23/30))*(s**((t-23)/30))
  rev=due[day%30]*factor
  nm=newmrr*(1+(0.38 if post else 0)*quality_after213)
  rev+=nm
  # Renewal annuity for each prior daily new cohort at 30d intervals.
  for age in range(30,t+1,30):
   # stronger post-t11 retention applies once cohort is billed after d213
   rs=min(.96,newsurv+(0.20 if day>=213 else 0)*quality_after213)
   rev+=nm*(rs**(age/30))
  # compute follows base active factor plus approximate new active cohorts.
  # weekend periodicity: baseline compute0 denotes weekday; weekends about 60% observed.
  wkfac=.60 if day%7 in (5,6) else 1.0
  compute=compute0*factor*wkfac
  # Added organic active compute approximation, low in near term.
  active_new=0
  rs2=min(.96,newsurv+(0.20 if post else 0)*quality_after213)
  for age in range(0,t): active_new += (nm/58.0)*(rs2**(age/30))
  compute += active_new*0.50*wkfac
  cost=compute+28000+60000+leads*.5
  cash+=rev-cost
  if t in (7,28,84,182):out[t]=round(cash)
 print(name,out)
